_comment: Candidate sources for the BCJR/APP benchmark literature phase. 'reported_title' is what a web search claimed; verification compares it against the record. A mismatch is the mashup-fabrication signal, not a formatting nit. The two 2026-dated entries were withheld from the first run and added afterwards on purpose: a run in which every candidate passes says nothing about the checker's ability to catch a bad reference, and search-summarised recent IDs are the likeliest place for a fabrication to hide.
